review: Request: at round 30 Kai (health 100, satiety 85, energy 39.4, on forest floor at 13.83, 16.30 within reach of canopy-69, fallen branches with 2 visible units, forest-dry-grass-0 and forest-berry-1, owning item-24-kai-284, three berries, and having mastered examine-material@1 and construct-weather-shelter@1) asked for a way to investigate and, only where physically possible, obtain or make a length reference suitable for examining shelter materials, because examine-material@1's length and diameter readings need a serviceable item with a verified length calibration and none is established; body dimensions, coordinates, stock counts and assumed unit sizes do not qualify, investigation must not create, consume or reserve anything, and an impossible result must be reported as an obstacle. World Agent decision: develop (learning 2) one general operation with modes investigate, transfer, verify, resume and cancel; the smallest executable precursor is the investigation of one accessible nominated candidate per action (1 round, 0.2 energy, nothing consumed, reserved or moved) that records observed suitability, provenance or the specific missing prerequisite, may find an explicitly non-metric uncalibrated comparison length, and reports only the scoped conclusion; transfer needs a real serviceable reference with an independently justified length, unit, uncertainty, resolution, range, provenance and revision, a suitable whole carrier, light and an actual comparison method, otherwise the obstacle with zero fabrication progress; verify is a separate paid comparison that publishes a record in examine-material@1's schema; study 2 rounds at 0.2. Whether a qualifying standard can exist here: no. examine-material@1 accepts a length tool only through a complete verified measurementCalibration record (processing on an item, data on an object); no mechanism installed in this run (the forest, open and expression foundations, prepare-ventilated-food-storage@1, construct-weather-shelter@1 and examine-material@1) writes one; names and marks are separate sign objects with no physical effect on a piece; a person's radius, world coordinates, stock counts, the recipe and rack dimensions and the display scale are engine conventions the specification excludes; the represented rod and strand dimensions are what a comparison would read, not a standard. So investigate is fully executable now, and transfer and verify are implemented against a declared calibration record, shown on test fixtures, and refuse in this run before any cost with the missing standard named. Implemented (full specified scope, not a first release): length-reference@1 (ability and handler long.length-reference, equivalence measurement:length-reference:investigate-transfer-verify:1, learning 2 at 0.2 energy per study round, 2.5 thousand code units, registered last, no visual component, no satisfaction source, events prefixed length-reference-). Parameters mode, target (shared resolver), source and carrier (resolved with the same exact-identity resolver inside the handler so a refusal can always name the missing standard). investigate: target is examine-material@1's target (own item, loose item or material source within reach, not reserved, not under a hazard) or any other object within reach; one round and 0.2 energy; it reports observed facts (examine-material@1's qualitative traits: material, form, hand feel, wholeness, setting, worked state; the candidate's calibration status from examine-material@1's own record check: no record, an incomplete or unverified record with the failing fields, a stale record with its round, a balance, or a complete verified length calibration with its form, resolution, uncertainty, range and standard; and whether it is an uncalibrated comparison span), unsupported claims (any length in metres or another unit; any sign naming or marking it, quoted, as carrying no length; the separated geometry of a unit still in its source) and unknowns (its length in any unit, straightness and end squareness beyond hand and eye, standards among candidates not examined, and visual traits in the dark), plus the probe-observe visible state of a source (mirrored, not called), whether it could be a transfer carrier, and newFinding false when the same unchanged candidate gives the same finding; the conclusion lists this person's examined candidates and is "no qualifying standard established among these examined candidates: ..." unless one was found qualifying when examined. A whole, rigid, plain, sound, unfractured, separated wood unit sighted along in light is a comparison span and gets a second personal record labelled non-metric (unit null, metric false, calibration none); a unit in place, a strand, food, a partial, worked or worn piece is not, and in the dark straightness is not judged. transfer (1 round, 0.2 energy) requires a source that passes examine-material@1's calibration check for length (carried or within reach, complete, verified, serviceable, calibrated before now) and a different carrier that is exactly one separated whole rigid plain sound wood unit, the person's own or loose within reach, not already carrying another instrument's record or a current verified span, and no longer than the source range; light; energy; and no other pending transfer. It lays the carrier alongside the source, aligns one end, reads the far end with examine-material@1's reading rule and records a pending comparison (value, uncertainty, source and carrier digests, evidence) in the person's state; no marks are made, nothing is consumed and the carrier is unchanged; a source too coarse to give any reading is a paid limit with no pending work. verify (1 round, 0.2 energy) revalidates the pending comparison (same source and carrier, both records unchanged, light, energy), reads again and, if both readings agree within the alignment window, writes on the carrier processing.measurementCalibration with verified true, form reference-length, quantity length, unit m, resolution and range equal to the span, uncertainty, standard (the source standard through the source id), method, evidence, calibratedAt, revision length-reference@1 and condition, plus span, both readings, placements, source revision, evidence and uncertainty, the comparison event, the carrier digest and the supported use; disagreeing readings are a paid failure with no record. resume runs the next step with the recorded ids at that step's cost: verification while the comparison is valid, otherwise a new comparison; cancel is free, refunds nothing and leaves the carrier as it is. An environment hook, active only with this revision installed, marks a verified record stale (verified false, round, reason, event length-reference-stale) as soon as the plain carrier's unit-record digest changes; examine-material@1 then refuses it and time never restores it; reverification is a new paid comparison and verification. Death clears the pending transfer (event length-reference-stopped); no lock or reservation is ever held. Every refusal precedes payment and lists all reasons: no or unresolved target, source or carrier, beyond reach, hazard, another person's item, a source in place or object as carrier, the carrier as its own source, unsuitable carriers, a balance, unverified or worn source, a carrier longer than the source range, darkness, too little energy, a pending transfer elsewhere, a different source or carrier at verification, or a changed source or carrier record; a refusal with no valid source adds the missing-standard statement and zero fabrication progress. Events investigated, aligned, verified, unverified, cancelled, stale and stopped carry view metadata (operation, mode, actor, target, source, carrier, source revision, status, calibration state unknown, comparison-only, pending, verified, stale or failed, units, span, range, resolution and uncertainty only when verified, marks always empty, step, progress, rounds, position, overlay, evidence, visibility as a private record with no outward change, and a label that never shows a ruler, ticks or a verified state unless verification completed). No reward: the review's bounded pleasure proposal was not implemented because this handoff excludes rewards; personal records are unverified, no event carries a qualified flag and the practice evidence event never qualifies. What Kai can do now: study for 2 rounds (0.4 energy), then for 0.2 energy a round investigate canopy-69 in place, forest-dry-grass-0, the berries or any other reachable candidate and learn that none carries a calibration record and that the conclusion is "no qualifying standard established among these examined candidates"; after gathering one branch unit, investigate it in daylight to record it as a non-metric comparison span; every transfer, verify or resume is refused at no cost naming the missing standard. A throwaway check on the archived round-30 world (in memory only) installed the package: Kai mastered it at round 32, investigated canopy-69 (in place, not a span), the berries (not an elongated wood piece) and forest-dry-grass-0 at 0.2 energy each with the growing scoped conclusion, two transfers were refused at no cost with the missing standard, and after gathering a branch after dark its investigation reported straightness not judged; examine-material@1 refused that branch as a tool because it carries no calibration record. Assumptions: (1) with no installed mechanism for durable physical marks, the transferred span is the carrier's whole end-to-end length between its natural ends, so transfer is one comparison round with no marking round, uses one placement, and refuses a carrier longer than the source range because stepping a source along it needs intermediate marks; laying off a shorter span, graduation intervals and subdivisions are handed off as the missing marking mechanism, and the parameters therefore offer no quantity, interval or marking tools and the property is length only; (2) a comparison span or carrier is a whole separated wood unit with the ex21 rod geometry that construct-weather-shelter@1 measures, rigid at flexibility 3 or less, plain, at condition 0.75 or more and not fractured, and a represented rod is taken as straight when sighted along in light; (3) the comparison reads the represented rod length with examine-material@1's reading rule, and the conservative uncertainty is placements x (source uncertainty + one source resolution, half a graduation at each end) plus the difference of the two readings, never reduced by repetition; (4) the two readings must agree within placements x the source resolution; an unchanged piece reads the same in this representation, so disagreement is a guard shown in the test by altering the pending record; (5) a single span has resolution and range equal to itself, so examine-material@1 reads lengths only as whole spans with that uncertainty plus half a span and reports diameters as below resolution; (6) source validity is exactly examine-material@1's check, and declared provenance is trusted because only reviewed package code writes these records; (7) a calibration is current while examine-material@1's unit-record digest of the plain carrier, without position or owner, is unchanged, and a calibrated carrier counts as worked under construct-weather-shelter@1's existing plain-part rule, so it cannot also be built into a shelter; (8) each step is atomic, so one pending transfer per person is kept in the person's state without any lock, waiting advances nothing, and an interrupted round completes no step; (9) the conclusion covers the candidates in the person's bounded log of 16 steps, each as found when examined; (10) investigation is paid in the dark with visual traits not seen, while transfer and verification need the light at which the ex19 checks see surfaces. Reuse: examine-material@1's target resolution, qualitative traits, calibration check, reading rule and unit-record digest, through an additive export block at the end of its source file that changes no behavior and leaves its package hash unchanged; shelterMeasure and WEATHER_SHELTER.sound of construct-weather-shelter@1; openRemember of foundation-open@1 (probe observe mirrored; probe, consult and navigate are not called, so their own costs apply only when used: records are read with consult and travel is navigate); expressionSign of the expression foundation, read only; forestResolveReference; ex19MaterialContact, ex19MaterialDark and ex19MaterialWhole; openConditions and forestClimate. No existing package changed: the test asserts one digest over all 121 previously registered packages (validation-results/scratch/ex24/hashes-before-4.json, taken before this change) and the individual hashes of foundation-forest@1, foundation-open@1, small-combustion-source@1, cutting-edge-assessment@1, construct-weather-shelter@1 and examine-material@1. Narrowed: the examine-material@1 test now checks that its package is the third ex24 package and that the scope's first three packages are the rack, the shelter and the examination, instead of registered last with an exact set. Checks: pnpm typecheck, eslint with no warnings and prettier on the five changed files, this test (7 tests), the two long-run scenario tests and every test of experiments 19 to 24 (24 files, 234 tests) passed.
